name: Pension Wieshof
beschreibung:
Overview

The Wieshof guesthouse – at the same time the Wieshof snack station – is located in the hamlet of Hinterthiersee in the municipality of Thiersee in the Tyrolean Thiersee Valley. The house of the Wechselberger family stands halfway up the ski descent of the Tirolina ski area in Hinterthiersee and is very popular as a stop-off for skiers. The illuminated toboggan run also begins directly at the house. The guesthouse is a starting point for holiday guests and is especially suitable for families with children, hikers and nature lovers; business and club outings as well as groups of up to 18 people are also welcome. The accommodation offers spacious double or multi-bed rooms with washbasins; the other sanitary facilities such as showers and WC are located on the floor. A cosy breakfast and lounge room offers plenty of space for playing and lingering, and Wi-Fi is available free of charge throughout the house.

History/Background

The Wieshof is run as a traditional family business by the Wechselberger family and combines a snack station (inn) with a small guesthouse. The guest rooms and parlours kept in Tyrolean style give the stay a homely atmosphere. The small but fine menu offers dishes made with products that come predominantly from the family's own farm or from the region – accompanied by a glass of red wine, a freshly tapped beer or a non-alcoholic drink. Anyone who does not want to travel on after stopping for a bite can spend the night in the cosy guest rooms at a reasonable price. The business thus stands for the agriculturally shaped snack-station culture of the Thiersee Valley on the edge of the Kaiserwinkel.

Getting there

From Germany, the journey leads via the A8 Munich–Salzburg, exit Irschenberg, then on via Bayrischzell and Landl, or via the Inntal motorway, exit Oberaudorf, via Tatzelwurm, Sudelfeld, Bayrischzell and Landl. From Tyrol or from Innsbruck, the route runs via the Inntal motorway, exit Kufstein Nord, then on via Vorderthiersee to Hinterthiersee. On site, drive to Hinterthiersee, turn left at the sawmill and follow the signpost to the Wieshof snack station (approx. 1 km). By train, the Oberaudorf or Kufstein stations are suitable; from Oberaudorf take a taxi to Thiersee-Hinterthiersee (approx. 25 km), from Kufstein take the post bus or a taxi (approx. 20 km). The airports of Innsbruck, Salzburg and Munich are each about a two-hour drive away.

Tips

For house guests, toboggan hire is free, and the illuminated toboggan run begins directly at the house – ideal for a winter evening. Dogs are allowed for a small flat fee. The snack station is open from mid-March to mid-December, closed on Wednesdays; payment is in cash. For skiers, the Tirolina-Haltjochlift valley station in Hinterthiersee is only about 1.4 km away. Families will find family-friendly rooms as well as a breakfast and lounge room with plenty of space to play; children's discounts are available on request.

Best time to travel

The Thiersee Valley region is suitable for every season: in winter, the ski descent of the Tirolina ski area and the illuminated toboggan run directly at the house are the main attractions, in summer the hiking and the lakes of the surroundings. According to the operator, the snack station is open from mid-March to mid-December, with Wednesday as a closing day; a reservation is recommended.
